kb_proposals: InextensibleThrough W (every open W, every causality), SplitBy W S (S Cauchy in W) and IsAcausalOn W S (S Cauchy in a causally arc-connected W) are theorems on every T1, second countable space: Causal.Causality.inextensibleThrough_of_t1_secondCountable, splitBy_of_t1_secondCountable, IsCauchySurfaceOn.isAcausalOn_of_t1_secondCountable (CausalScaffold.ErsSecondCountable); they discharge every hthrough, hthrough₂, hthroughτ and hsplit of NestedCausalities, ErsUniqueness and ErsMughd, as kb/0142 does for hext/hmext.

In the agent shell `grep` is a ugrep wrapper (shell function: -G --ignore-files -I); on papers/*/legacy/labeled/*.tex (ASCII, lines over 1400 characters) it returned nothing, silently, even for `grep -c ""`: use /usr/bin/grep on the paper sources.
notes: (1) Resumed from the interrupted closer's file (restored unchanged, built, no sorry). Kept every statement; added the explicit imports the target names (Causal.NestedCausalities, Causal.ErsUniqueness, besides Causal.CurvesExtendSecondCountable and Causal.ErsMughd; all already transitive), rewrote the docstring to the kb/0006 contract (labels unmarked within the first 1400 characters, the paper quoted, a paper-facing hypothesis checklist, SCOPE), added ers_corollary_4_73_of_isCauchySurfaceOn_secondCountable (4.73 with u₁ a GHD read as S Cauchy in U₁ for C, plus U₁ causally arc-connected for C, in place of hacausal and hsplit) and its witness, and replaced timelikeLine_isCausal by causal_ladder (from timelikeLine_globallyHyperbolic) in the 4.72 witness. (2) Mechanical check: the elaborated type of each of the six _secondCountable theorems equals that of its original with exactly hmext and the through-hypothesis deleted and [SecondCountableTopology M] inserted after [T2Space M] (normalised #check strings compared). #print axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only, for all 12 declarations. (3) Layer 1: the four imports have model_path None in tools/ladder.py's lean_index; the witnesses use only timelikeLine and its lemmas from Causal.Lines, Causal.LinesCurves and Causal.ErsUniqueness (ETT layer). No statement mentions a metric, a curve length or a geodesic. causal_ladder is used in both witnesses (IsCausal from GloballyHyperbolic); in the main theorems no remaining hypothesis is a ladder consequence of another. (4) For the keeper (T-lad-record-curves-corollaries): the [[consequence]] ERS Lemma 4.72 at curve_nested gains the witness Causal.Causality.ers_lemma_4_72_secondCountable, standing [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M], whose `under` loses 'curves_extend of C'' and 'through every point of U₁ ∩ U₂ an inextensible causal curve of U₂ for C': what remains is curve nesting on U₂, is_causal of C', S acausal for C', S Cauchy in U₁ for C' and in U₂ for C. Its matrix does not move (curves_extend is already a [[fact]]). (5) For the binder (T-bind-curves-corollaries) and the curation (master): rows 4.72, 4.73, 4.74, 4.79, 4.80 can take the new declarations; curves_extend then leaves their localisation (its minkowski geometric `by` Causal.minkowski_curvesExtend is no longer needed). Row 4.72 then asks only is_causal of m (Causal.minkowski_isCausal, model layer), curve_nested (T-loc-quasilinear-nesting, unbuilt) and the readings accepted by DEC-161 (c) and DEC-162; it stays unmarked until curve_nested has a supplier and the composition with Minkowski is written in a model module (one line: ers_lemma_4_72_secondCountable with Cm the Minkowski causality and hm := Causal.minkowski_isCausal). (6) For T-abs-ers-4-64-second-countable: it can import this module for inextensibleThrough_of_t1_secondCountable, splitBy_of_t1_secondCountable and IsCauchySurfaceOn.isAcausalOn_of_t1_secondCountable; 4.73's Cauchy-surface form is already here, so that target need not redo 4.73. (7) Graduation (kb/0015, kb/0025): scaffold/CausalScaffold.lean does not import this module yet, so the axiom sweep does not see it; the file imports only Causal.* modules, so moving it to Causal/ErsSecondCountable.lean is a file move. No name clashes with the concurrent CausalScaffold.CExtConnexeSecondCountable (checked by grep). (8) DEC-167 (gluing in defi:causalite, a future refactor): nothing in this file reads or builds the sheaf clause; AgreementGlues and SolutionsGlue glue agreement and solutions, not the causality; the statements quantify over Causality M and stay textually as they are; only the witnesses' timelikeLine would need the new field, upstream in Causal.Lines. Observation for the author, not a defect of the paper: the curve ERS take at :983 (past inextendible from x in U₂) and the extension of m-causal curves need no Lorentzian input; on a T1, second countable background they are theorems of the causal topology alone.
